title: Yellow Spicy Vietnamese Chicken Noodles
description: A peppery and crunchy Vietnamese dish featuring blackcurrant jam, perfect for a sick day, and is halal-friendly.
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions.
In a large bowl, whisk together the blackcurrant jam, soy sauce, fish sauce, and lime juice.
Add the grated ginger and minced garlic to the bowl and stir to combine.
Slice the chicken breast into thin strips and add to the bowl, tossing to coat with the sauce.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken until browned and cooked through.
Add the cooked noodles to the bowl with the sauce and toss to combine.
Add the cooked chicken to the noodles and toss to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve immediately and garnish with sliced green onions and toasted peanuts if desired.
